The consistency review (MS-0MW2XMBD5006UV3N, parent epic MS-0MW20VBSZ003A01O) found that the `core/` submodule's README still describes Main Street staff with the superseded framing:

> **Multi-Use Card Economy**: ... staff cards expand hand capacity with ongoing costs.

Staff are now two types (business staff vs management-company staff, GDD Appendix D.4), and only management-company staff grant hand capacity.

This file lives in the separate Tableau-Card-Engine repository (`core/` submodule, TheWizardsCode/Tableau-Card-Engine), so it cannot be changed from this repository; the fix must be raised and merged there.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `core/README.md`'s Main Street row no longer states that staff cards expand hand capacity as their defining role; it names the two staff types.
2. The change is merged on the engine repository's `dev` branch and the submodule pin advanced in this repo when that is the normal practice (separate pnpm/npm bump if required).
3. Any engine-repository work item that tracks the change is referenced here.

# Loan payoff dialog: carry the payoff across a paused closing

discovered-from:MS-0MW3SN58E009HC84

## Goal (user story)

As a player whose loan retires in a turn that also pauses on an event-choice
dialog (or a bankruptcy bailout offer), I want to still see the debt-free
congratulation once the pause resolves, so that no payoff goes unnotified.

## Context

`MS-0MW3SN58E009HC84` presents the payoff dialog in the closing presentation
slot (`MainStreetLoanPayoffModel.presentLoanPayoffDialogs`), after the closing
animations and ahead of the End of Turn summary. Two pauses resolve **after**
that slot, so their payoffs are currently never presented:

- **Event choice**: `processEndOfTurn` retires the loan and then pauses
  (`choicePending`) before `finishTurnPresentation` reaches the presentation
  slot. The resume path (`onEventChoice` → `finishDeferredEndOfTurn`) builds a
  fresh result that does **not** carry `loanPayoffs`.
- **Bankruptcy bailout**: the deferred result pauses on the loan offer
  (`pendingLoanOffer`); `onLoanOfferChoice` resumes through
  `completeDeferredClosingTail`, which never presents payoffs. A declined offer
  ends the run, so game over correctly wins there; an **accepted** offer
  continues the run with no congratulation.

The paused path never duplicates a dialog (there is only one presentation slot),
so this is a *missed* notification, not a duplicate.

## Desired change

Carry the paused closing's `loanPayoffs` into the resumed flow (the same
pattern `pendingBankingHint` uses for the banking hint) and present them via
the existing `presentLoanPayoffDialogs` sequencer on the continuing resume
path — never on a resume that ends the run (game over wins).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. An event-choice-paused closing that retired a loan presents exactly one
   congratulation when the choice resolves, and never two.
2. A bailout-paused closing where the seat accepts an offer (the run continues)
   presents exactly one congratulation; a declined offer (the run ends)
   presents the game-over overlay and no congratulation.
3. The dialog still appears only after the closing presentation and never
   alongside another modal.
4. Unit tests cover both pause paths, including the no-duplicate rule.

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerTurnFlow.ts` — carry the payoffs across
  `presentEventChoiceDialog` / `presentLoanOfferDialog` and present them on the
  continuing resume.
- `src/scenes/MainStreetLoanPayoffModel.ts` — `presentLoanPayoffDialogs`
  (reused unchanged).
- `tests/main-street/loan-payoff-turn-flow.test.ts` — the pause/resume cases.

## Constraints

- Presentation only: no engine, arithmetic, wallet or RNG change.
- One modal at a time; the summary/bailout/event-choice pacing is unchanged.
data.title: Loan payoff dialog: carry the payoff across a paused closing

# Write tabbed P&L overlay browser tests (MS-0MW4XULA90002OEY)

## Summary

Write browser tests for the tabbed profit/loss overlay in both single-player and competitive modes.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Tests exist in `tests/main-street/turn-summary-pl-overlay.browser.test.ts`.
- Tests verify the tabbed P&L panel renders with correct P&L lines (income, expenses, adjustments, net) for the selected player.
- Tests verify the human ("You") tab is selected by default when the dialog opens.
- Tests verify tab switching: selecting another player's tab updates the whole statement body to that player's figures.
- Tests verify single-player mode shows a single non-interactive "You" tab.
- Tests verify the dialog uses existing overlay conventions (hudContainer parenting, depths 199/200/201, overlay dismissal, reduced-motion safe, instant appearance).
- Tests verify the [ Next Turn ] / [ Bank Loan ] buttons remain functional.
- Tests verify the selected tab is preserved after the in-place re-render following a loan take.
- All tests pass with no implementation yet (red-first). Tests import from the overlay module.

- At least one automated test per surfaced P&L line and tab behaviour (model tests for the P&L/tab projection; browser overlay tests for rendering, the default tab and tab switching); all related documentation is updated (`docs/game/ux-visual-audio.md` Turn Summary sections); and the full project test suite passes.

## Dependencies

None — tests import types from existing engine types.

## Deliverables

- `tests/main-street/turn-summary-pl-overlay.browser.test.ts` — browser test file

# Implement tabbed P&L overlay (MS-0MW4XULA90002OEY)

## Summary

Replace the existing single-player `showTurnSummaryDialog` and competitive `showCompetitiveTurnSummaryDialog` with a single unified tabbed P&L overlay that presents each player's management company as a profit/loss statement.

## Acceptance Criteria

- A unified `showTurnSummaryDialog` function replaces both the single-player and competitive layouts. It renders a tab strip (one tab per player, human/"You" default) plus the P&L statement body for the selected tab.
- Single-player mode shows a single non-interactive "You" tab. Competitive mode shows one interactive tab per non-eliminated player.
- Selecting a player's tab switches the entire statement body to that player's P&L figures.
- The P&L layout matches the model output: Income section (base/synergy/reputation/events with total), Less: Operating expenses (staff/community/business with total), Incident and One-off adjustments, emphasised Net profit/loss.
- Non-monetary figures (reputation/score change, closing balances, businesses owned) appear as supplementary context outside the P&L lines.
- The existing [ Next Turn ] / [ Bank Loan ] behaviour is preserved, including in-place re-render after a loan take while preserving the selected tab.
- The loan descriptor (`buildTurnSummaryLoanDescriptor` / competitive equivalent) and bank loan action seam keep working.
- The overlay uses existing conventions: `createOverlayBackground` + `createOverlayButton`, `hudContainer` parenting, depths 199/200/201, `s.overlayObjects` for dismissal, instant appearance (reduced-motion safe), `safePlaySound` for button SFX.
- Tabs are operable by pointer and keyboard.
- All browser tests pass (see child MS-0MW5EQHFK005NXXM).

- Each player has its own tab; the human ("You") tab is selected by default when the dialog opens, and selecting another player's tab switches the whole statement to that player's figures.
- One unified tabbed P&L replaces both the single-player `showTurnSummaryDialog` and competitive `showCompetitiveTurnSummaryDialog` layouts. Single-player shows a single non-interactive "You" tab. Every value shown today is preserved — either as a P&L line or in the supplementary context — and no `TurnResult` ledger field changes.

## Dependencies

- MS-0MW5EQ0BA004E4QY (Implement P&L projection model) — provides the projection function
- MS-0MW5EQHFK005NXXM (Write overlay browser tests) — must pass

## Deliverables

- `src/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts` — unified `showTurnSummaryDialog` and `showCompetitiveTurnSummaryDialog`
- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnSummary.ts` — tab model consumed by overlay
- Existing browser tests pass

## Key Files

- `src/scenes/MainStreetOverlayContent.ts` — new unified tabbed overlay layout
- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnSummary.ts` — P&L projection and tab model
- `src/scenes/MainStreetTurnControllerTurnFlow.ts` — gate may be unchanged
- `tests/main-street/turn-summary-pl-overlay.browser.test.ts` — consume overlay (test child)

## Risks

- The competitive panel carries more per-seat figures than the single-player dialog. The unified layout must keep all of them.
- Re-presenting after a loan take must rebuild the statement for the currently selected player and not reset unexpectedly.
data.title: Implement tabbed P&L overlay
